summary: Nicholas Baltuch, 35, of Denver fell ~75 ft near Hays Creek Falls around 12:35 p.m.; USFS staff, Carbondale Fire & Ambulance, and Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers carried him out to the coke ovens near Redstone, where a helicopter flew him to Valley View Hospital; condition not reported
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; US Forest Service; Carbondale Fire & Ambulance
